cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've written you a ticket like the baker gave you. Now, how long do you need my umbrella?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He gave me a receipt. I just need the umbrella till I reach the bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, a receipt for the loan. Write your return time where he put the price.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm asking a friend for a favor, and my bus is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write 'no charge,' then. I'll approve it while you sign.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 copies a baker's receipt as a permission ticket; B2 corrects it and A3 rebrands it as loan documentation, with A5 still requiring approval/signature.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 bus duration produces A3 return-time field; B4 friendship and bus urgency prompt A5 no-charge and concurrent approval.

relationship.evidence: B2 gives a practical duration and B4 invokes friendship plus urgency, not an arbitrary setup question.

heightening.evidence: A5 accommodates B4 favor only as a zero-price transaction with approval still required.

specificity.evidence: A1 umbrella and ticket, B2 bus and receipt establish the absurd documentation without extra backstory.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 no charge then concurrent signing is compact and responsive; A3 copied price field is concrete.
